source: Confirmed — not individually enumerable (see note) — see note: Not a fixed operation enum like the other Purview workloads. Microsoft logs nearly every SDK message in the Microsoft.Crm.Sdk.Messages namespace (create/read/update/delete, multi-record view, export to Excel, report view/export/render, and all other SDK-layer calls against Dataverse -- hundreds of distinct message names, one per entity/action combination) EXCEPT an explicit exclusion list of ~26 messages (WhoAmI, RetrieveFilteredForms, TriggerServiceEndpointCheck, QueryExpressionToFetchXml, FetchXmlToQueryExpression, FireNotificationEvent, RetrieveMetadataChanges, RetrieveEntityChanges, RetrieveProvisionedLanguagePackVersion, RetrieveInstalledLanguagePackVersion, RetrieveProvisionedLanguages, RetrieveAvailableLanguages, RetrieveDeprovisionedLanguages, RetrieveInstalledLanguagePacks, GetAllTimeZonesWithDisplayName, GetTimeZoneCodeByLocalizedName, IsReportingDataConnectorInstalled, LocalTimeFromUtcTime, IsBackOfficeInstalled, FormatAddress, IsSupportUserRole, IsComponentCustomizable, ConfigureReportingDataConnector, CheckClientCompatibility, RetrieveAttribute). Requests are additionally bucketed into categories by name prefix (RetrieveMultiple/ExportToExcel/RollUp/etc. -> 'ReadMultiple'; Retrieve/Search/Get/Export -> 'Read'). The full literal message list lives in a separate, unrelated .NET SDK reference (Microsoft.Crm.Sdk.Messages Namespace on learn.microsoft.com), not in an audit-log operation table -- copying that huge SDK namespace in as if it were documented audit-log operation values would misrepresent its source, so it is not done here.
